name: Claude Skill Editor
headline: Claude skill editor for creation and modification
short_description: Create and edit Claude skills with a desktop app. Operations teams can streamline skill development and deployment. Drag-and-drop installation simplifies integration with Claude agents.
author: jackmastermind

sections.overview:
Claude Skill Editor is a desktop application that streamlines Claude skill development by eliminating the need to manage separate folders, create ZIP archives, and use external text editors. It provides a built-in Monaco text editor for skill creation and editing, plus one-click drag-and-drop installation directly into Claude Desktop. Users can organize skills with multiple files and subfolders while managing everything from a single interface. The tool integrates seamlessly with Claude Desktop, Web, and app-store versions, making it ideal for operations teams, AI engineers, and developers who frequently create and iterate on custom Claude skills.
Rapidly prototype and iterate on custom Claude skills without manual packaging
Manage multiple skill files and subfolders in a centralized editor
Deploy skills to Claude Desktop and web versions with drag-and-drop simplicity
Streamline skill development workflows for operations and engineering teams
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jackmastermind/claude-skill-editor`
sections.usage:
```
Create a new Claude skill for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The skill should help with [SPECIFIC TASK], using [DATA] as input. Include a detailed description, example outputs, and step-by-step instructions for using the skill.
```
Copy

```

- **Downward Trend**: [SPECIFIC TREND] is decreasing by 8% year-over-year.

### Recommendations
- **Action 1**: Increase investment in [SPECIFIC AREA] to capitalize on upward trends.
- **Action 2**: Reallocate resources from [SPECIFIC AREA] due to downward trends.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
